observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. Each shows a squat, barrel-bodied, four-legged creature with stubby elephant-like toed feet. The body is pale tan with dark brown mottling across the back. The skin is hairless and folded, and there are no feathers or wings anywhere. The head is pinkish, deeply wrinkled bare skin. It has a protruding fleshy flap mouth and no beak. A large pale, translucent, veined pouch glows warm yellow under the throat. South is the front and east a side profile. North is the rear, with a short tapered tail, hindquarters and the back of the head; the edges of the throat pouch show at the sides. All three are about the same height.
observed.south.png: Front view. Wrinkled pink head with two small dark eyes and a drooping, open, lipless flap of skin for a mouth. Below it hangs a big rounded, translucent throat-fan with red branching veins, lit warm from within. Round mottled body with four thick legs. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: True side profile facing right. Big rounded mottled back, a short tail at the left, four thick stumpy legs. Wrinkled bare-skinned head with a small eye. The mouth is an upturned fleshy flap, with no beak. A veined, backlit throat-fan bulges under the jaw. No wings or feathers. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view: rump, a short tapered tail, hind legs, mottled back, and the back of the wrinkled pink head above. No face and no eyes. The pale throat-fan peeks out at both sides. It is narrower than south but the same height. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature is small beside the vanilla human, about a third of a cell tall, roughly rat-to-cat size. At 32 px/cell it is a tiny tan speck with a pale belly, smaller than the rat.

request.subject: RM_Chellow

edits.change: Draw the chellow as a squat, round, feathered bird-like flyer standing on two thin legs, its body covered in feathers everywhere except the head, with two wings folded neatly against its sides.

The two folded wings are clearly identifiable, symmetric, tucked along the flanks, with wing tips resting over the lower back. They turn consistently with the body: both visible in front and rear views, the near wing shown in side view.

The silhouette is an alien squat orb: a round feathered body with a short tail tuft, two slender legs, folded wings integrated into the outline, and a veined translucent throat-fan hanging from the underside of the bare head as a distinct lobed shape. It reads as a small round whistling bird-thing, not a hippo or any barrel-bodied quadruped.

invariants: bare wrinkled featherless head, skin only
no beak; a lipless flap of skin where the mouth would be
translucent veined throat-fan hanging below the head, faintly backlit
transparent background, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, clean dark outline
exactly one creature, centred, whole body visible
request.prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the chellow, a small flying bird-like creature seen at rest on the ground. Squat and round feathered body, like a plump ball of plumage, standing on exactly two thin legs, with a short tail tuft. Two wings are folded neatly and symmetrically against its sides, wing tips resting over the lower back, clearly visible as wings. The body is feathered everywhere except the head. The head is entirely featherless: bare wrinkled skin from crown to neck. There is no beak; in place of a mouth is a lipless flap of skin that vibrates to whistle. Below the head hangs a translucent throat-fan, a distinct lobed membrane that it inflates to carry its call, crossed by fine veins and lit faintly from behind. The silhouette is a compact alien orb of feathers with the bare head and the glowing fan hanging at the front. In the rear view, seen from behind, the folded wings, back and tail tuft show, and the bare head is turned away with the throat-fan hidden. In the front view, eyes toward the viewer, the bare face, flap mouth and full throat-fan show. In the side view the near folded wing and one leg show in profile. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour, clean dark outline. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
